brief.t: START HERE: Call Jedwards and obtain the lot-specific Tocopherol COA, then forward it to Evelyn before the material is used.

ACT NOW 1: Tocopherol has arrived, but Evelyn is waiting for the COA and could not verify receipt of it. The request is 1 calendar day old and the missing document may block QC release. Send: Alexandra, please send the lot-specific COA for the Tocopherol shipment now so QC can release the material today.

ACT NOW 2: Polo TR#47618 / EMCU8614105 was scheduled for pickup October 9, but pickup, release, and current location remain unverified. Polo or PLL may be waiting; confirmation is 5 calendar days late and free time expired October 12. Send: Vic, please confirm the container's physical location, pickup and release status, and any storage or demurrage now accruing. If it remains at the terminal, send today's recovery appointment.

ACT NOW 3: Marcello requested 500 additional TALOVA lip balms, while delivery of the prior 15,000 units remains unverified. Marcello has been waiting 5 calendar days. Send: Marcello, I am confirming stock and build timing for the additional 500 and delivery proof for the prior 15,000 now. I will give you both answers today.

next: Recommendation: Clear the Tocopherol COA first because material is physically on site but may remain unusable, then close Polo and TALOVA.
Displaced: Roon Body moved below Act Now because the new Tocopherol documentation gap may block QC release today.
Scheduled: 7 operational items. The nearest dated milestone is Bulk Naturals shipment 99139, expected October 16; facial-pad samples are expected October 19 under tracking 8784 2707 2819.
Noise: At least 38 Outlook messages, none operationally urgent.

Source gaps: CRM and WhatsApp browser sessions are signed out. Purchasing has no current records to rule out other supplier, QC, inventory, or lead-time risks. The Email lane did not return a fresh reply during the response window. Missing data is not zero.
signal: Tocopherol is on site without a verified COA. Polo container movement remains unverified five days after pickup. TALOVA's additional 500-unit need and prior delivery remain unresolved.
